strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Ship WBD with one public TCP-shaped FakeTCP association per Transport Lane. FakeTCP owns the public sequence space from SYN. The first bounded reliable phase carries Firefox-120-like TLS 1.3 / Reality-like admission, then the same association switches in-band without FIN/RST/new SYN to pinned wolfSSL DTLS 1.3 -> LINK/lane-local FEC/VPN datagrams. Sustained payload must not inherit ordinary kernel-TCP cumulative-stream HOL.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: Requalify the current PR #9 source after Logical Tunnel/raw-IP changes. Preserve the mature FakeTCP/TCP-like recovery core. The older exact-tested ed7b717d candidate is historical only; current feature HEAD is 898f627ce041b10bf858f3824685d09dcd0cc7ef and has a deterministic red single-flow LINK full-stack gate that must be resolved before any new package is delivered.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not return to the retired dual-public-flow Reality TCP -> close -> FakeTCP design. Do not retune FakeTCP recovery/ACK/SACK/FEC without deterministic evidence. Do not deliver a Windows or Linux package until the exact same source HEAD has current green Windows-native and Linux/raw-netns qualification, including single-flow setup, DTLS, LINK and no-HOL evidence.

architecture_override.authority: explicit user hard requirement beginning 2026-08-29 and still active
architecture_override.required_public_flow: Exactly one TCP-shaped 4-tuple and one SYN lineage per Transport Lane. The public WBD flow is FakeTCP-owned from SYN through teardown.
architecture_override.bootstrap_phase: A bounded reliable ordered FakeTCP setup stream carries real TLS 1.3 / Reality-like admission during the first seconds; production persona remains Firefox-120-like where technically possible.
architecture_override.mode_switch: Authenticated setup switches in-band on the same FakeTCP association to DTLS/datagram mode with no FIN, RST, reconnect or new SYN at the boundary.
architecture_override.hol_rule: Reliable ordered behavior is setup-only. Post-switch payload must retain the mature WBD FakeTCP/DTLS/FEC datagram behavior and must not acquire ordinary kernel-TCP cumulative-stream HOL.
architecture_override.tcp_like_core: The existing FakeTCP/TCP-like recovery core is considered mature and should remain frozen unless a deterministic regression specifically proves it must change.
architecture_override.delivery_rule: Before user delivery, the exact candidate HEAD must pass both hosted Windows-native qualification/build and Linux raw/netns full-stack qualification. Physical Windows Npcap/NIC/NAT/ISP remains a final non-equivalent acceptance layer, but no package should be handed to the user while automated Windows or Linux gates are red.

validated_findings.single_flow_architecture: The product no longer uses ordinary Reality TCP -> close -> second FakeTCP SYN. FakeTCP owns the public flow from SYN; the initial reliable setup stream carries Reality-like TLS admission and the same association switches to DTLS/LINK/FEC.
validated_findings.prior_physical_windows_ingress: The earlier physical Windows `faketcp: not ipv4/tcp` startup failure was attributed to unrelated Npcap ingress reaching a strict handshake parser; later production ingress classification filters exact unfragmented inbound WBD IPv4/TCP four-tuples before parsing and has Windows-native ordered-noise regression coverage. Treat the old log as historical unless the exact failure reappears on a newer candidate.
validated_findings.prior_physical_linux_success: Physical Linux evidence showed at least one single-flow session reaching WBD_SINGLE_FLOW_BOOTSTRAP_READY, DTLS ACCEPT_PASS/READY and WBD_LINK_MUX_SESSION_READY, proving the single-flow architecture can complete on real Linux; startup stability still requires exact-head qualification before delivery.
